verdict.rationale: Resend's own docs say it can be added to Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients, and its .well-known/mcp.json points to an official resend/resend-mcp repository. Docs also show the MCP server being used for domain verification and headless webhook management. Missing for 10: detailed MCP setup, auth and tool-coverage documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Add Resend to Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients.
You can add and verify a domain you own in four ways: in the Domains Dashboard page, using the Resend API, with a Resend CLI command, or with the Resend MCP server
Build custom headless webhook experiences from the API, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server.
